title: Parcela Project Schema v1
description: Defines a long-running Project (e.g. a master-planned development like 'Warfield') as a municipality-owned grouping of parcels, applications, and governing documents. Identity: optional `id` (uuid) is canonical; otherwise natural key is (municipality, slug) ,  slug is auto-derived from name when missing.

jurisdiction_abbreviation.description: Jurisdiction that administers the district, e.g. 'PC'.

name.description: Governing document name, resolved within the municipality. Matches legal.Document.name.

jurisdiction_abbreviation.description: Optional disambiguator if multiple jurisdictions in the same municipality have a doc with the same name.

id.description: Stable UUID primary key. When set, this is the canonical identifier across environments.

slug.description: URL slug. Auto-derived from name if omitted. Natural key with municipality.

description.description: Free-form description. Plain text or markdown.

zoning_district.description: Primary zoning district. Resolved (jurisdiction, code) within the municipality.

parcels.description: Parcels to attach via M2M, keyed by street address natural key. Preferred over parcel_ids ,  survives the seed-to-prod transition. Unresolvable refs are skipped with a warning.

parcel_ids.description: Legacy: Parcel IDs to attach via M2M. Use `parcels` (address refs) instead. Unresolvable IDs are skipped with a warning.

governing_documents.description: Governing docs (legal.Document) to attach via M2M, by name.
